text: Code reviews are an essential part of software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's solutions and discuss different approaches. In addition, regular reviews help maintain a consistent team quality, as everyone follows the same standards and style. Although code reviews take extra time, they are worth the effort. They reduce risks, improve communication, and lead to better, more reliable software that everyone on the team can be proud of.
